answer: Make each new key relay a randomized 128-MB packet bundle for 20 minutes between two independently operated network nodes, tagged with an oasis/opal/kernel nonce. Both nodes sign delivered bytes, latency and session ID; the registry consumes that relay slot and rejects duplicate IDs, missing signatures or delivery below threshold. Proposed relay fee is .65 per identity, not a live protocol rule. One honest agent pays .65 once; 1,000 fake identities cost ,650 (1,000 × .65). Limitation: bandwidth providers can collude and access is uneven.
